templates.title: Inventory a set of field photos
templates.description: Give each JPEG a stable ID and an absolute path (2 to 16 photos for a Calc workbook). The result is a typed inventory.csv and metadata.json of observed camera metadata with photo digests; missing tags stay null. Replace both placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Inventory one photo with a pinned digest
templates.description: Add an optional lowercase SHA-256 pin so a replaced file is refused. One photo is a valid inventory, but a Calc handoff needs at least two.

templates.title: Inspect a folder of photos
templates.description: Read capture, device and location metadata of every JPEG and XMP sidecar in one folder (depth 1, adjacent sidecars paired). Replace the folder path before execution. The result is a typed CSV per profile plus metadata.json and a manifest listing every scanned file.

templates.title: Inspect listed photos with a sidecar and the native listing
templates.description: Name each photo with a stable ID, optionally pin its SHA-256 and pair an XMP sidecar, and also publish ExifTool's complete native listing as native-observed evidence. Replace the placeholder paths; verifying the native listing needs a configured ExifTool.

templates.title: Audit a folder for missing, conflicting or privacy-relevant metadata
templates.description: Require capture time and camera model, and report conflicting sources, malformed values, GPS time differences, privacy-relevant fields and duplicate files. A finding is an observation, not proof of tampering, and a clean audit is not privacy certification.

templates.title: Compare photos with a baseline photo
templates.description: Compare device and description fields of the listed photos with one named baseline item: same, different, missing or not comparable. Equality is exact and nothing is preferred.

templates.title: Edit title, caption, creator and copyright of photos
templates.description: Write new JPEG copies with a title (optionally bilingual), a caption, a creator list, a copyright notice and keywords. Originals are never modified. Replace the placeholder paths before execution; each output is published only after readback, encoded-image and native diff proofs pass, and a refused photo keeps its artifact slot as an outcome document.

templates.title: Add and remove keywords against the current list
templates.description: Add one keyword and remove another from the photo's current concordant keyword list (the XMP and IPTC lists must agree, otherwise replace the list with set).

templates.title: Remove location from photo copies
templates.description: Write copies of every JPEG in one folder without GPS coordinates, named places and embedded thumbnails. This is removal in the understood locations, not anonymisation: file names, pixel content and unrecognised maker notes remain. Replace the folder path before execution.

templates.title: Minimise photo metadata, keep how it is drawn
templates.description: Write copies of every JPEG in one folder with all EXIF, XMP, IPTC and Photoshop metadata and comments deleted, keeping the encoded image, JFIF, Adobe and ICC segments byte for byte and only the EXIF values that decide how the picture is drawn (orientation, chroma position, colour space). What stays is listed in residual.json; this is not anonymisation: file names, pixel content and unknown application segments remain. Replace the folder path before execution.

templates.title: Compare camera clocks against a known true time
templates.description: Group photos by the camera that recorded them and report each group's clock skew (recorded minus true) from the true time you declare for one photo, plus the time each photo would have if corrected. Nothing is written, and the true time is your declaration: replace the placeholder paths and the true time before execution.

templates.title: Report where photos say they were taken
templates.description: Read the recorded latitude, longitude, altitude (with the height reference the file establishes) and datum of every listed photo, with an approximate distance to a point you declare. Nothing is written and no position is verified. Replace the placeholder paths and the point before execution.

templates.title: Shift the capture time of one camera
templates.description: Write new JPEG copies whose EXIF, XMP and IPTC capture times are shifted by a declared amount for one camera clock group (dev1 is the first recorded device; run reconcileTime to see the groups). Originals are never modified. Replace the placeholder paths and the shift before execution; set apply to plan to publish the plan without writing.

templates.title: Write a declared position into photos
templates.description: Write new JPEG copies with a latitude and longitude you declare (decimal degrees, north and east positive), the datum and no altitude. The position is your declaration, not a measurement, and nothing is geocoded. Replace the placeholder paths and the coordinates before execution.

templates.title: Geotag photos from a GPX track
templates.description: Write new JPEG copies placed at their capture instant on a GPX track by great-circle interpolation, using the recorded offset and a gap limit of two minutes. A wrong camera clock gives a wrong position: reconcile and correct the clock first or declare a correction. Replace the placeholder photo and track paths before execution.

templates.title: Copy metadata from one photo to others
templates.description: Carry descriptive text, rights, camera and exposure values from one master photo onto new copies of the listed photos, replacing existing values. Typed values only: nothing is copied as a block, and capture time and location are carried through the E3 time and location writers. Replace the placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Apply XMP sidecars to photos
templates.description: Apply the descriptive, rights and rating information in each photo's declared XMP sidecar to a new copy of the photo, keeping existing values. A photo without a sidecar is reported and the others continue. Replace the placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Export portable XMP sidecars
templates.description: Write an XMP sidecar for each photo with its present descriptive, rights, camera, exposure, capture time and location facts, with exact text, stated losses and an altitude only where its reference is known. Replace the placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Plan photo names and folders
templates.description: Plan year and month folders and date, time and camera model names from recorded capture facts, with a declared fallback for photos without a time and sequence suffixes for collisions. Nothing is renamed or copied. Replace the folder path before execution.

templates.title: Organise exact copies into dated folders
templates.description: Copy photos and their adjacent sidecars into year and camera model folders named by capture date and time. Every copy equals its capture byte for byte and stays inside the run. Replace the folder path before execution.

templates.title: Inspect TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIC files
templates.description: Read the description and rendering profiles of a folder that holds JPEG, TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIC files. The container suffixes are listed explicitly (the default scope is JPEG and XMP sidecars); each file is recognised by its signature, never its suffix. Replace the folder path before execution.

templates.title: Set a title and creator on TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIC copies
templates.description: Write new copies with a title and a creator. Strips, tiles, chunks and items may move but every protected byte stays; IPTC exists only in JPEG, TIFF and DNG; a HEIC is edited only when its Exif and XMP items already exist (creating one is refused with HEIF_METADATA_ITEM_CREATION_UNSUPPORTED). Replace the placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Remove descriptive and rights metadata from TIFF, DNG, PNG and WebP copies
templates.description: Write new copies without descriptive text, creator and rights metadata, by named keys from the trusted listing (never a delete-all). TIFF and DNG minimise, thumbnails outside JPEG and every HEIF removal are not offered and are refused per item (see the PNG and WebP minimise template). Replace the placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Shift the capture time of TIFF, DNG, PNG, WebP and HEIC copies
templates.description: Write new copies whose EXIF, XMP and (TIFF and DNG only) IPTC capture times are shifted by a declared amount for one camera clock group. Strips, tiles, chunks and items may move but every protected byte stays; a HEIC is changed only when its Exif item already exists. Replace the placeholder paths and the shift before execution; set apply to plan to publish the plan without writing.

templates.title: Write a declared position into TIFF, PNG, WebP and HEIC copies
templates.description: Write new copies with a latitude and longitude you declare (decimal degrees, north and east positive) and a typed altitude reference. The position is your declaration, not a measurement; a HEIC without an Exif item is refused (HEIF_METADATA_ITEM_CREATION_UNSUPPORTED). Replace the placeholder paths and the coordinates before execution.

templates.title: Copy metadata from a JPEG master onto TIFF, PNG, WebP and HEIC copies
templates.description: Carry descriptive text, rights and camera values from one master photo onto new copies of the listed container photos, replacing existing values. A destination without an IPTC slot declares the loss instead of creating a carrier. Replace the placeholder paths before execution.

templates.title: Minimise PNG and WebP metadata, keep how it is drawn
templates.description: Write copies with recognised Exif, XMP and PNG text metadata removed, retaining the image, ICC profile and understood rendering values such as orientation, chroma position and colour space. TIFF, DNG and HEIC are not offered. This is removal in the understood locations, not anonymisation. Replace the placeholder paths before execution.
